description:
Micro Intelligence
Provides features like tap to awake, awake on device raise, etc. Disabling this app makes you unable to use specific settings like Gesture Navigation and Action & Gesture along with other phone features. I recommend using RUN_IN_BACKGROUND ignore if you wanna keep them.
Pithus analysis: https://beta.pithus.org/report/f7358ad68b27d9fa75a8e742ad43c64f2710b4ba5378ee825215ebbd08549275
